mapper.insert: INSERT INTO std_product ( product_code, product_name, product_type, on_sale, registered_at, source_system, event_type, extracted_at, consumed_at ) VALUES ( #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{productType}, #{onSale}, #{registeredAt}, #{sourceSystem}, #{eventType}, #{extractedAt}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (product_code) DO UPDATE SET product_name = EXCLUDED.product_name, product_type = EXCLUDED.product_type, on_sale = EXCLUDED.on_sale, registered_at = EXCLUDED.registered_at, source_system = EXCLUDED.source_system, event_type = EXCLUDED.event_type, extracted_at = EXCLUDED.extracted_at, consumed_at = now()
